description: This PHP file defines the EmployeeTerminationDao class, which manages database operations related to employee termination records within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, and listing termination reasons.

classes.name: EmployeeTerminationDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for handling employee termination records and related data retrieval operations.

methods.name: saveEmployeeTermination
methods.description: Saves an EmployeeTerminationRecord entity to the database.

methods.name: getEmployeeTermination
methods.description: Retrieves an EmployeeTerminationRecord by its ID.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonList
methods.description: Returns a list of all termination reasons, ordered by name.
